ai_label: [AI-GENERATED CONTENT BY AIFEL TEAM ASSISTANT :: AIFEL-AI-LABEL-V1]
approval: Sonam explicitly approved these defaults in this conversation on 2026-11-19.
data_domain: Supplied inventory associations; entirely synthetic signals and outcomes.
target: New confirmed degradation in (t,t+30 minutes]; confirmation occurs at the end of the second consecutive bad interval.
exposure: Unprotected simulated services. Each service takes the worst latency/loss of its declared attached resources. This is not a verified forwarding path or an assertion about real protection.
evidence: At least 5 of the previous 6 intervals must have valid performance for every attached resource; newest valid service observation must be no older than 10 minutes. Otherwise abstain. Optional feed unavailability is explicit.
maintenance: Only schedules known by prediction time are features. Maintenance never automatically reduces risk.
episode_mix: Cycle six scenario families evenly; independently sample condition trajectories, target resources, observation noise and delays. This is not a production class-prevalence estimate.
split_unit: Whole independent episodes in generation order; all services/resource events within an episode stay together.
model: Random Forest on as-of-time numeric features; identifiers and scenario/hidden-state/outcome fields excluded.
baseline: Transparent heuristic evidence score, evaluated separately.
current_degradation: Separate operational status when the last two observed intervals confirm degradation; do not make a new-onset forecast.
claims: Simulation-domain evaluation only. No calibrated production outage probability, real-world accuracy, or unseen-topology validation.
